title: I do not know what to do
story: Sam opened the notice late, does not understand the amount, and is not sure of anything yet.
notice_text:
SAMPLE NOTICE - MADE UP FOR PRACTICE - NOT A REAL NOTICE

Dear Sam Example,

We paid you $[amount not shown on this page] more in benefits than you were due for the months listed on a page you cannot find. This happened because of a reason you do not understand.

If you do not repay or contact us, we will begin collecting.

(Dated 40 days ago. The name, amounts and dates on this page are invented.)
